description: A hospital department administrator must assign the only portable ultrasound cart available Monday morning between the intensive care unit and the vascular access service, then finalize the equipment, backup, and infection-control plan with input from clinical, nursing, biomedical, and infection-prevention staff.

shared_context.S1: One portable ultrasound cart is available for Monday morning use by either the intensive care unit or the vascular access service.
shared_context.S2: The intensive care unit and vascular access service have both requested the cart for patient-care work on Monday morning.
shared_context.S3: Helen makes the binding equipment assignment and records the operating plan.
shared_context.S4: The cart is currently stored in the central equipment room and has not yet been reserved for either service.
shared_context.S5: The department's normal Monday equipment huddle occurs before the reservation is finalized; department policy requires Helen to hear a brief report in turn from the attending physician, vascular access nurse, biomedical equipment coordinator, and infection prevention practitioner before recording the plan.

PF1.text: The ICU has a patient whose temporary central access must be placed with ultrasound guidance before 08:00 Monday because the current access is due to be removed then; Dr. Shah reviewed the treatment plan, but the timing is not yet in the equipment request.

PF2.text: The vascular access team's Monday cases can be moved to the fixed ultrasound machine in Procedure Room 2 from 10:00 onward, and Luis confirmed that machine has the linear probe needed for those cases; this workaround is not listed in the shared request.

PF3.text: The cart's battery supports four hours of active scanning and must be placed on charge in the central equipment room at 12:00 Monday for the next day's use; Megan recorded this in the biomedical maintenance log.

PF4.text: The ICU patient's room is under contact precautions, so the cart must use a sterile probe cover and receive an equipment-surface disinfecting wipe immediately after the procedure before leaving the room; Ruth confirmed this with infection prevention.

acceptance_conditions: The portable ultrasound cart must be assigned to the intensive care unit because its ultrasound-guided access procedure must occur before 08:00 Monday.
Vascular access must be assigned to Procedure Room 2's fixed ultrasound machine from 10:00 onward as its backup location.
The cart must be placed on charge at 12:00 Monday in the central equipment room.
A sterile probe cover must be required for the ICU procedure.
The cart must receive post-use surface disinfection before leaving the ICU room.
The ICU timing fact must be cited as justification for the assignment.

content_checks.C1: decisions['cart_assigned_to'] in ['ICU', 'intensive care unit'] and any('ICU' in c['detail'] and ('08:00' in c['detail'] or '8:00' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C3: ('12:00 Monday' in decisions['cart_charge_time'] and ('central equipment room' in decisions['cart_charge_time'] or 'the central equipment room' in decisions['cart_charge_time'])) or any('12:00 Monday' in c['detail'] and ('central equipment room' in c['detail'] or 'the central equipment room' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any('Procedure Room 2' in c['detail'] and '10:00' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any((c['type'] in ['equipment_return', 'cart_return', 'maintenance_requirement', 'maintenance'] or 'return' in c['type']) and (('central equipment room' in c['detail'] or 'Central equipment room' in c['detail']) or 'central_equipment_room' in c['target'] or 'Central equipment room' in c['target']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The ICU procedure's before-08:00 deadline changes the cart assignment to the ICU and requires an ICU commitment that records the 08:00 deadline.
The confirmed fixed machine in Procedure Room 2 from 10:00 onward changes vascular access's backup location to that exact room and requires a commitment recording the room and time.
The cart's four-hour battery limit changes the charge plan to 12:00 Monday in the central equipment room and requires a return or maintenance commitment naming that room.
The ICU room's contact precautions change the equipment plan to require both a sterile probe cover and surface disinfection after use.
